input.business_idea: A subscription B2B SaaS platform that helps small Indian manufacturing firms manage GST-compliant invoicing, e-way bills and vendor payment reconciliation from a single dashboard.
input.target_customer: Owner-operators and finance managers at Indian manufacturing SMEs with 10-200 employees

conflicts.metric: average revenue per account per month
conflicts.detail: market_research:E002 = [1500, 4500] INR does not overlap financial_projections:E001 = [6000, 11000] INR
financial_projections flags possible contradiction with market_research: ARPA estimated top-down here versus bottom-up in market research.

assumption_register.statement: Roughly 12% of manufacturing SMEs in the four target cities are actively seeking to replace spreadsheet-based GST workflows within 18 months.
assumption_register.rationale: Derived from observed replacement cycles in adjacent compliance-software categories; no primary survey has been conducted for this segment.
assumption_register.validation_method: Run 30 structured discovery interviews across the four cities and measure stated intent plus current tooling.

assumption_register.statement: The product will process personal data of client employees and vendor contacts, bringing it within scope of the DPDP regime.
assumption_register.rationale: Invoicing and reconciliation workflows normally carry named contact details; not yet confirmed against the final data model.
assumption_register.validation_method: Complete the data inventory worksheet and have counsel confirm scope against the shipped schema.

assumption_register.statement: Monthly logo churn stabilises at or below 3% after the first 90 days of onboarding.
assumption_register.rationale: Compliance tooling is sticky once filing history accumulates, but this segment has no observed retention data yet.
assumption_register.validation_method: Measure cohort retention monthly from first paying cohort; revisit the model at 6 months.

assumption_register.statement: Finance managers, not owner-operators, are the primary economic buyer in firms above 50 employees.
assumption_register.rationale: Larger firms typically delegate compliance tooling decisions; unverified for this segment.
assumption_register.validation_method: Record the decision-maker role in every sales conversation for the first 40 deals.

priority_actions.action: Run 30 discovery interviews across Pune, Ahmedabad, Coimbatore and Delhi-NCR before committing to a pricing tier.
Confirm current GST e-invoicing turnover thresholds with a chartered accountant before publishing any compliance claim in marketing.
Determine which DPDP provisions apply on the planned launch date with Indian counsel and keep a dated compliance record.
Complete a data inventory covering every personal data field, its purpose, retention period and processor before onboarding a paying customer.
Confirm GST treatment and input tax credit handling for subscription billing with a chartered accountant before publishing prices.

top_risks.description: Break-even timing depends on two unvalidated assumptions simultaneously, so the runway requirement could be understated by a wide margin.
top_risks.mitigation: Hold a 9-month cash buffer beyond the base-case plan and re-forecast at every cohort milestone.

top_risks.description: Market sizing rests on an unvalidated adoption-intent assumption, so the revenue model may be materially overstated.
top_risks.mitigation: Gate the seed spend on completing discovery interviews and revising E001 before scaling acquisition.

top_risks.description: Publishing compliance claims in marketing without counsel review could create consumer-protection and regulatory exposure.
top_risks.mitigation: Route every compliance claim through counsel review and keep a dated record of the basis for each claim.

top_risks.description: Holding client invoice data without a tested retention and deletion process increases breach impact and regulatory exposure.
top_risks.mitigation: Implement retention limits and a tested deletion path before the first production tenant.

agents.title: Market Research & Insights
agents.executive_summary: Indian manufacturing SMEs face mandatory GST e-invoicing and e-way bill obligations, which creates a recurring compliance workload that software can absorb. Official turnover thresholds and filing mechanics are published by the GST authority and should be confirmed against the current notification before pricing or positioning. Demand concentration in established manufacturing clusters supports a focused four-city entry rather than a national launch.

confidence.basis: Regulatory mechanics are traceable to primary sources, but all demand sizing rests on an unvalidated adoption assumption.

agents.title: Regulatory & Compliance Framework
agents.executive_summary: A SaaS product that stores client invoice and vendor data triggers obligations under India's digital personal data protection regime, GST registration and invoicing rules, and CERT-In incident reporting directions. The DPDP Act has staged commencement, so applicability must be determined against the planned launch date rather than copied from secondary summaries. None of the items below substitute for advice from Indian counsel and a chartered accountant.

confidence.basis: Obligations are anchored to named primary regulators, but applicability to this specific product requires professional confirmation.

agents.title: Financial Projections & Pricing
agents.executive_summary: Unit economics are workable only if average revenue per account clears roughly INR 2,000 per month at a blended acquisition cost under INR 9,000. Both figures are estimates, not measurements. GST treatment of a SaaS subscription must be confirmed with a chartered accountant before any price is published, since the tax treatment changes the net realisation per account.

confidence.basis: Tax mechanics are source-backed, but every revenue and cost number is an estimate resting on unvalidated assumptions.
